title: 7 trends that will revolutionize stock trading
主要内容: The article outlines seven trends set to transform stock trading in the coming years. One trend is the rise of digital stock avatars, which will function as personalized investment advisors using artificial intelligence. These avatars will manage portfolios based on investor preferences and adjust strategies in real-time. For instance, an investor could instruct their avatar to reduce exposure to Thailand, and the avatar would automatically modify the portfolio. Another trend is the creation of different share classes for the same company, enabling investors to target specific risk profiles. This could lead to specialized indices like a high-risk S&P 500. The article also mentions the potential for crowdsourcing and microinvesting, particularly for small-cap stocks, with companies raising funds through platforms similar to Kickstarter. The SEC is already considering regulations for such initiatives. Additionally, the article highlights the use of digital avatars to invest in early-stage start-ups, with videos verified by NASDAQ. It also notes the potential for a stock picker to outperform the index as data sets and computing power become more accessible. Wall Street may still exist, but with the rise of artificial intelligence and electronic trading, many traditional jobs may be replaced. Finally, the article suggests that the next Great Depression could occur in a millisecond due to the digitization of information.
